analysis_summary.notes: This patch (9.2.0762) is a pure refactoring: it extracts a static helper function completing_value_for_subopt() to replace ten repeated STRNCMP-based sub-option name checks in expand_set_diffopt(), expand_set_popupoption(), and expand_set_tabpanelopt(). The commit message states 'No functional change'. All 9 candidate hunks were reviewed individually and none constitute a compatibility change because: (1) the extracted helper is an internal static function, (2) every call site is semantically equivalent to the replaced inline code, and (3) the one incidental bug fix (is_borderhighlight was always false due to a wrong STRNCMP argument) had zero user-visible effect since is_highlight already covered the same path. No backward-compatibility impact is expected for any Vim release target.
